roles.title: Quality and Process Coordinator
responsibilities: Coordinate comprehensive quality management activities and production process optimization.
Lead continuous improvement implementation in production lines applying Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 standards and client requirements.
Conduct internal and external audits, treating non-conformities (RNCs) through 8D methodology.
achievements: Successfully achieved 1 recertification of the ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (QMS).
Achieved 1 maintenance audit of the QMS passed with zero critical non-conformities.
Strengthened operational quality and hygiene culture in the plant aligned with client standards.

roles.title: Quality Analyst and Manager
responsibilities: Development and execution of quality management strategies on the production line.
Quality analysis of raw materials and inputs in close collaboration with engineering.
Design and supervision of quality control procedures for every manufacturing stage.
achievements: 15% defect rate reduction in production processes thanks to systematic quality control workflow.
Designed and implemented customer complaint tracking system resulting in 30% complaint reduction.

roles.title: Quality and Production Manager
responsibilities: Comprehensive management of production and quality leading a multidisciplinary team.
Implementation of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies to maximize efficiency and reduce costs.
achievements: Implemented an automated quality control system that improved accuracy and speed by 30%.
Led Just-In-Time system rollout, reducing inventory costs by 25%.

roles.title: Senior Purchasing Analyst & Commercial Retail Management
responsibilities: Strategic and operational purchasing management of critical automotive production materials.
Leadership in procurement negotiating with suppliers to guarantee quality and JIT delivery.
achievements: Optimized supply chain reducing procurement costs by 15% through strategic negotiation.
Supplier development program that improved incoming quality, reducing complaints by 20%.
